edits.title: Remove unfinished implementation notes
edits.find:
<!-- TODO: Add details about producer, consumer -->
<!-- TODO: Add details about index -->

Aim to support multiple embeddings, each "run"
separate.
SQL db has raw data and run data.
Runs have indices.
Create smaller shards.
Shards need to be merged, have a merging script.
Once shards are merged they can be accessed via API.
edits.replacement: The pipeline supports multiple embeddings by treating each embedding configuration as a separate run. The SQL database stores both the raw corpus data and the run-specific passage metadata. Each run produces smaller FAISS shards, which are merged before being served through the API.
edits.comment: This section currently reads like drafting notes rather than publication-ready prose.
